presets.title: What each preset saves
presets.hint: Measured by running each preset on this file in memory. Nothing has been written yet.
presets.label: Preset
presets.custom: Custom settings, starting from {preset}. The saved size is measured when you save.
presetNote.lossless: No pixel is changed. Removes clutter and repacks the file.
presetNote.print: Images kept up to 300 dpi, JPEG quality 85. For printing.
presetNote.balanced: Images kept up to 150 dpi, JPEG quality 75. Sharp on any screen.
presetNote.small: Images kept up to 96 dpi, JPEG quality 60, metadata removed. For email and upload limits.
breakdown.none: This preset can't make the file smaller.
advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.fontTables: Remove font data viewers never read
advanced.subsetFonts: Keep only the glyphs used in fully embedded fonts
save.nothing: No smaller version was possible with these settings. Nothing was written.
save.signed.title: Save a copy without a valid signature?
save.signed.message: This document is digitally signed. The smaller copy will not carry a valid signature. The original is kept as it is.

more.hint: What was found, page by page

found.empty: Nothing stands out. This file is already lean.
pages.title: Page by page
image.label: {width}×{height} {colour}
compare.hint: Drag across the page to compare. Saving writes exactly the version shown here.
compare.preparing: Making the smaller copy to compare…
compare.diffNone: No visible difference at this zoom. Zoom in to look closer.
compare.diffSome: At this zoom, {percent} of the page looks different.
compare.diffFailed: The differences could not be worked out at this zoom. Try a smaller zoom.
compare.renderFailed: This page could not be drawn.
compare.lean: No smaller version is possible with these settings, so both sides are the same.
issue.heavyContent: {size} of drawing instructions: very detailed vector art or text drawn as shapes
issue.oversizedImageShared: {width}×{height} {colour} image ({size}) shown at {ppi} ppi, on {pages} pages
issue.offpageImage: Only {percent}% of a {size} image is inside the page

issue.inlineImages.one: {count} inline image ({size}) inside the drawing instructions
issue.inlineImages.other: {count} inline images ({size}) inside the drawing instructions

issue.fullFont: Font {name} embedded in full ({size}), first used here
issue.editorData: Editor data for re-editing in its source app ({size})
issue.unreadable: Drawing instructions could not be fully read; figures for this page are incomplete

finding.oversizedImages.title.one: {count} image stored at more detail than shown
finding.oversizedImages.title.other: {count} images stored at more detail than shown

finding.oversizedImages.detail: Resolution is measured from the size each image is drawn on the page. The sharpest is {ppi} ppi as placed; 150 ppi is sharp on screen and 300 ppi in print. Downsampling is lossy.

finding.recodableImages.title.one: {count} more image can be made smaller
finding.recodableImages.title.other: {count} more images can be made smaller

finding.recodableImages.detail: Their resolution already suits the screen. Photographs stored losslessly or as heavy JPEGs can be re-encoded, and Small also lowers them to 96 ppi. Both are lossy; flat graphics stay lossless.
finding.unsupportedImages.detail: PDF Epsilon does not recompress {reason} images yet, so these are kept exactly as they are.

finding.unsupportedImages.over.one: {count} of them is drawn above 187 ppi and could be downsampled once supported.
finding.unsupportedImages.over.other: {count} of them are drawn above 187 ppi and could be downsampled once supported.

finding.offpageImages.detail: Parts of these images fall outside the visible page and are never seen; as little as {percent}% of one is visible. Clipping paths are not counted, so even less may show. Cropping them is planned.

finding.undrawnImages.title.one: {count} image not drawn on any page
finding.undrawnImages.title.other: {count} images not drawn on any page

finding.undrawnImages.detail: They are referenced by the file, for example from annotations, patterns or page resources, but were not found in page content. They are kept, and only compressed to the page size.

finding.fontTables.title.one: {count} font carries data no PDF viewer reads
finding.fontTables.title.other: {count} fonts carry data no PDF viewer reads

finding.fontTables.detail: Screen bitmaps, kerning and layout tables used by other applications. Viewers draw text from the outlines, which are kept exactly, so every preset removes the rest. This is lossless.
finding.fullFonts.detail: Every glyph was stored, not just the ones used. Every preset keeps only the glyphs the pages draw: the pages look the same and text stays searchable, but these fonts can no longer type new text.
finding.fullFonts.detailNotYet: Every glyph is stored, not just the ones used. PDF Epsilon cannot subset fonts of this kind yet.

finding.fullFonts.notAll.one: {count} of them is of a kind PDF Epsilon cannot subset yet.
finding.fullFonts.notAll.other: {count} of them are of a kind PDF Epsilon cannot subset yet.

finding.repeatedFonts.title.one: {count} typeface embedded more than once ({copies} copies)
finding.repeatedFonts.title.other: {count} typefaces embedded more than once ({copies} copies)

finding.repeatedFonts.detail: The same typeface is stored as separate subsets, typical of merged PDFs: {fonts}. Merging them into one copy each needs font rewriting and is planned.
finding.duplicates.detail: Identical images, fonts or drawings are stored more than once. Every preset keeps one copy and points everything at it. This is lossless.
finding.thumbnails.title: Embedded page thumbnails
finding.thumbnails.detail: Previews stored for old viewers. Every current viewer draws its own, so every preset removes them.
finding.editorData.title: Editor data from Illustrator or Photoshop
finding.editorData.detail: A private copy that lets the source application re-open the file fully editable. The pages look the same without it. Balanced and Small remove it.
finding.metadata.title: XMP metadata
finding.metadata.detail: Descriptive data such as editing history. Only Small removes it.
finding.metadata.pdfa: Removing it breaks this file's PDF/A conformance.
finding.unusedObjects.title: Objects nothing refers to
finding.unusedObjects.detail: Left behind by earlier edits. They are not part of the document, and every preset drops them.
finding.rewrite.title: The file structure can be packed tighter
finding.rewrite.revisionsTitle: Saved {count} times on top of itself
finding.rewrite.revisionsDetail: Each incremental save appends its changes and keeps the earlier version, about {size} here. Rewriting keeps only the current version, which also ends any revision history a signature relies on.
finding.rewrite.noObjectStreams: Objects are stored one by one instead of in compressed object streams.
finding.rewrite.uncompressed: {size} of drawing instructions are stored uncompressed.

finding.heavyContent.title.one: {count} page with very heavy drawing instructions
finding.heavyContent.title.other: {count} pages with very heavy drawing instructions

finding.heavyContent.detail: Detailed vector art, charts with many points, or text converted to outlines. Simplifying it would change the drawing, so it is left as is.
finding.tagging.title: Accessibility tags
finding.tagging.detail: The structure tree lets screen readers follow the document and reflow it. It is always kept.
finding.signed.title: This document is digitally signed
finding.signed.detail: Any compression rewrites the file, which makes the signature invalid. Keep the original wherever the signature matters.
finding.pdfa.title: Archival PDF/A-{level}
finding.pdfa.detail: Small removes XMP metadata, which PDF/A requires. Use Balanced or a lighter preset to keep it archival.
finding.hiddenLayers.title: Hidden layers
finding.hiddenLayers.detail: Some layers are switched off by default. Their content is kept and counted, even though it is not visible.
finding.presetFailed.title: {preset} could not be applied
error.notPrepared: The smaller copy is no longer ready. Open the comparison again.
error.io: Could not read or write the file.
error.parse: This does not look like a readable PDF.
error.encrypted: Encrypted PDFs are not supported yet.
error.tooLarge: The file is too large for PDF Epsilon (over 2 GB).
error.tooComplex: The file has too many parts for PDF Epsilon to handle safely (over a million objects).
error.verify: The smaller file failed verification, so nothing was written. The original is unchanged.
error.internal: Something went wrong inside PDF Epsilon.
